candidates.name: Uterine Leiomyoma
support_spans: presumed progressive uterine fibroids 6 months earlier
Hypoechoic mass measuring approximately 6.2 cm in diameter, with an irregular border over the right adnexa
Moderately enhanced right adnexal tumor with an otherwise normal pelvic structure
Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube
Spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells around numerous blood vessels
Loose fibromyxoid stroma without mitotic atypia
Positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors
candidates.why: The patient's presentation and imaging findings are consistent with a uterine leiomyoma, also known as a uterine fibroid, which is a common benign tumor in women of reproductive age.
